ideas.title: Have an idea? Let AI help you act
ideas.body: Planning a trip or a small team project? Tell tabdo what you want and what you already know. Let AI clarify the content, plan steps, then update records and set rules.
ideas.card1Title: Say what you want, then clarify the next step
ideas.card1Body: Drop scattered ideas and notes into the workspace. Let AI organize information and plan steps. When you need new rows, edits, or status changes, keep chatting and it will act.
ideas.card2Body: Whatever AI does lands in the workspace. Inspect records, edit directly, pause and change direction, then tell it what to do next.

examples.travelBody: Capture places, dates, and budget. Let AI organize what you already have and what’s left to do. When plans change, update records or adjust in chat.
examples.projectTitle: Team projects with a clear next step
examples.projectBody: Organize tasks, owners, and progress. Let AI help plan steps and update status. Review and edit with teammates as the project moves forward.
examples.toolsTitle: The right tools for the idea
examples.toolsBody: Collect input with forms, track progress on boards, summarize with reports. Turn repeat updates into automations — or let AI run them — while you stay in control.

team.title: Solo or with a small team
team.body: Organize ideas in your own workspace, or invite teammates. Configure AI assistants with the methods and tools that fit how you work.

cta.title: Start with one thing you want to do
cta.body: Tell tabdo your idea, bring in what you already have, and let AI help with the next step.
cta.footnote: Ideas start with you. Direction stays yours.
